Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.4879 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of F.I.R in Crime No. 109 of 2020 of Phirangipuram Police Station, Guntur District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.
The petitioners are A-1 and A-2 in Crime No.109 of 2020 of Phirangipuram Police station.
A case under Sections 188, 273, 420 r/w 34 IPC and under Sections 58, 59, 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was registered against them.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this is a covered matter and this Court, as per order passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, quashed the F.I.Rs registered against the petitioners therein based on identical facts with similar allegations and the similar sections of law.

Therefore, he would submit that the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of F.I.R.
5.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor also fairly concedes that this is a covered matter and this Court, in a batch of criminal petitions in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, has quashed the F.I.Rs registered under the aforesaid sections of law.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate orders accordingly.
6. The petitioners have also produced the copy of the order passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch by this Court.

As can be seen from the aforesaid order, this Court has quashed about 55 F.I.Rs registered under the aforesaid sections of law against the petitioners therein based on identical facts with similar allegations.

7. Therefore, in view of the above order of this Court, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the F.I.R registered against the petitioners herein in Crime No.109 of 2020 of Phirangipuram Police Station,
Guntur District, is hereby quashed.
